full_query: So the singulair is an oral tablet not an inhaler?
sentences: Yes, Singulair (montelukast) is an oral tablet, not an inhaler
It is commonly used for the management of asthma and allergic rhinitis
Montelukast works by blocking leukotrienes, which are chemicals in the body that cause inflammation, bronchoconstriction, and mucus production
